name: Vantage
description: An architecture practice working in concrete, glass and daylight. Housing, civic buildings and the occasional small chapel.
canvasAlt: Slow graphite gradients drifting behind the page, like light moving across a concrete wall

sections.heading: We build for the light that is already there
sections.body: Vantage is a small practice working in concrete, glass and daylight. Housing, civic buildings, and the occasional small chapel.

sections.heading: A site visit before a sketch
sections.body: Every commission begins with a day on site and nothing to show for it. Where the sun lands in February matters more than what the plan looks like on paper.

sections.heading: Rooms should be quiet before they are clever
Three materials, honestly joined
sections.body: Board-marked concrete, oak, and glass with as little frame as the structure allows. We detail the junctions rather than hide them.

sections.heading: Terraces that age well
sections.body: Our housing work is mostly infill: narrow plots, awkward orientation, neighbours close on both sides. Constraints make the plan.

sections.heading: Four architects, one studio, no satellite offices
sections.body: We take on a handful of projects a year so the person you meet is the person drawing. Planning, tender and site are all handled in house.

sections.heading: Tell us about the site
sections.body: Send the address, the orientation and roughly what you need from it. We reply to everything, including the projects we are not right for.
